title: published-article
description: An article on the hub or the corporate site. Lite envelope (D-005) plus the corporate site's article fields in snake_case (D-016, D-010), canonical and origin. id equals slug; pub_date and updated_date are the dates the site shows, created and updated are the envelope's.

seo_title.description: Search title for <title> and og:title; the page headline stays title

related_hubs.description: Corporate directory hub paths (segments/<slug>, platforms/<slug>, providers/<slug>)

canonical.description: URL of the original when this is a syndicated copy (D-002)

origin.description: The site the article first appeared on
